text: Lithuania’s national defence system is failing to keep pace with military needs, putting at risk plans to establish a fully equipped army division by 2030, Auditor General Irena Segalovičienė warned Wednesday.
title: Auditor: Lithuania needs higher defence spending to meet military goals

text: One prerequisite for creating a joint Baltic military force would be an agreement on which units would be placed under a common military commander, when that subordination would take effect and how extensive the commander's decision-making authority would be, Meelis Oidsalu writes.
title: Meelis Oidsalu: Could the Baltic states have a common military?
